decisions.reason: The assessment-date copy change is already fully represented by the candidate's message 50 MODIFY, so no additional or edited Event is needed.
Changing the assessment-date field format does not alter the required fonts, icons, design assets, or final asset-package inclusion.
The assessment-date field format does not change the requirement that completed templates be straightforward to export as PDFs.
The distribution-warning refinement is an independent clause already represented by its own message 50 MODIFY; the assessment-date change adds no further impact.
The assessment-date placeholder decision does not change the vehicle identifier, its customer-specific option, or its clean-line presentation.

The source change applies to the page-one assessment-date field and does not necessarily change footer content or formatting; the separate page-4 footer issue is already represented as runtime evidence.
Changing the assessment-date field does not alter the required result-driver content, bullet format, or level of detail.
The assessment-date amendment does not change the established cross-variant visual theme, and the message's retention of the overall design direction merely reaffirms existing state.
The page-one assessment-date field amendment does not change the coverage, presentation, or example text of internal-page headers.
The assessment-date field format does not alter the front-page result panel, score heading, result fields, prominence, or visibility.
The assessment-date amendment does not change the required DX-17 identifier in the internal-page header.
The assessment-date field amendment does not change the DX17–DX20 variant set, its editability, or its score-and-risk-based selection rule.
